detail.command: echo '=== uvx ==='; command -v uvx || true; uvx --version 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== python ==='; command -v python3 || true; python3 --version 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== homebrew ==='; command -v brew || true; brew --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true; echo '=== blender ==='; if [ -x '/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender' ]; then echo '/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender'; '/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender' --version 2>/dev/null | head -1; else echo 'Blender app not found in /Applications'; fi
